steps: Use existing private job.recoveryRun handle, or select exactly one existing recovery namespace after matching current account/key locally; never emit namespace/IDs/token or create a new run as recovery.

Reuse maintained verify-final.js via verifier.call({job:{recoveryRun}}) only after current source-proof/controller/account/token revision/idle fences pass. It performs two fresh metadata passes of exactly3 retained IDs with GET only. Existing exact-file-final-version check may fail on drift; preserve that failure rather than waive the recorded final state.

Keep complete current metadata privately and cross-check API sameIDs against Drive web and G: via unique tagged parent/name mapping; capture full parent/trashed/visibility/version evidence privately, export booleans. Existing verifier safe summaries alone do not preserve a fresh raw snapshot or prove web/G.

Before recoverable residual cleanup, separately list descendants ONLY of exact two tagged owned folders with complete bounded pagination; reject any non-ledger descendants/unknown ownership/incompleteSearch. No blanket folder cleanup.

Keep DRIVE_MUTATIONS_ENABLED false. Implement one narrow task-owned disposable mutation permit shared between canonical controller and driveFetch. Avoid runtime replacement of trashDriveFile/moveDriveFile or extracted shadow controller being reported as literal product controller.

Permit admission starts from explicit reviewed private created-ID ledger, current account/auth/data/controller/source owner and fresh server metadata. Require exact run tag + role + ownedByMe + MyDrive + creation receipt and current parents/version. Move target must be a ledger-owned tagged folder with canAddChildren. Reject originals, arbitrary IDs, appData, folder PATCH, upload routes, sharing and DELETE. No automatic namespace discovery as authority.

Move controller globalflag rejection after safe read-only preflight only for this explicitly selected disposable operation. Mint an opaque controller-only one-request capability (private Symbol plus issued-permit registry); consume it at driveFetch after exact method/path/query/body/file/action/target/owner/version checks. No global mutable allowWrite or new OAuth grant. Full-grant driveWrite capability is still required, read-only operation otherwise fails safely.

Preserve existing lock/journal/owner fences/no transparent PATCH retry/independent fresh GET before local UI success; normal unchanged menu/select/confirm/list/selection/folder update path invokes canonical controller. AppData allowance remains independently scoped.

For actual bulk UI proof create at least2 new uniquely tagged small valid synthetic image/video media fixtures under new approved owned folders using existing granted account; old text/plain singleton is insufficient. Build and preserve a matching explicit private creation/allowlist journal; never upload over originals. Existing fixed3-role metadata-only creator is not directly reusable for arbitrary bulk media upload.

Run normal actual selection→move→trash from UI with approved exact targets, fresh API confirmation and web/G same-ID comparison. Preserve original byte hashes and before-state; then recoverably restore or trash ONLY these task-created residuals after fresh descendant inspection. Keep private receipts and unknown/error history.

Controlled permit tests must distinguish allowed exact current tagged task item from original/arbitrary/folder/appData/DELETE, forged/stale permit, changed account/token/source/controller/tag/version/parents, wrong body/target, duplicated permit and missing driveWrite.

Use actual unchanged bulk UI with two approved disposable fixtures to verify successful vs failed item separation, unknown-submit fresh GET and retained selection/list state. Do not replay old canonical writes merely to relabel MU01/02.
Compare API/web/G current states and final recoverable residual prestate; no permanent deletion or ordinary original-media mutations. Actual execution held until root GO after state/watch.
